
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(colf)
library(ggthemes)
library(Metrics)
source(here("helper/run_k_fold.R"))

adult_bd <- read_csv(here("adults/adult_exposure_duration.csv"))

adult_aligned_eig <- read_csv(here("simulations/sim_adult_exposure_duration/01_linked_sim/linked_aligned_eig.csv"))
adult_resnet50_eig <- read_csv(here("simulations/sim_adult_exposure_duration/01_linked_sim/linked_resnet50_eig.csv"))
```


```{r}
adult_kfold_aligned_eig = run_all_kfold(sim_data = aligned_eig, behavioral_data = adult_bd)

adult_kfold_resnet50_eig = run_all_kfold(sim_data = adult_resnet50_eig, behavioral_data = adult_bd)


saveRDS(adult_kfold_aligned_eig, here("cached_data/adult_kfold_aligned_eig.Rds"))
saveRDS(adult_kfold_resnet50_eig, here("cached_data/adult_kfold_resnet50_eig.Rds"))
```





```{r}
adult_kfold_aligned_eig <- readRDS(here("cached_data/adult_kfold_aligned_eig.Rds"))
adult_kfold_aligned_eig %>% 
  arrange(-mean_rsquared)


adult_resnet50_eig %>% 
  filter(param_id == 17) %>% 
  mutate(trial_type = if_else(trial_number == 1 & trial_type == "deviant", "background", trial_type)) %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(x = trial_number, y = mean_sample, color = trial_type)) + 
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lb_sample, ymax = ub_sample)) +
  geom_line()+
  theme_few() 
```



```{r}

adult_kfold_resnet50_eig %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_rsquared)) + 
  geom_histogram() 

aligned_eig %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = trial_number, y = mean_sample, color = trial_type)) + 
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot", position = position_dodge(width = .2))+ 
  theme_few() 


 
adult_bd %>% 
  #filter(trial_number != 11) %>% 
   ggplot(aes(x = trial_number, y = total_rt, color = trial_type)) + 
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot", position = position_dodge(width = .2))+ 
  theme_few() 


aligned_eig %>% 
  filter(param_id == 93) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = fam_duration, y = mean_sample, color = trial_type)) + 
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot", position = position_dodge(width = .2)) + 
  theme_few()
```
